title: AI Optimized Routing and Resource Allocation for Quantum Enabled Non Terrestrial Industrial Networks
summary: The industrial transformation of Industry 4 and 5 results in cyber physical production systems that require secure resilient and energy efficient connectivity over integrated terrestrial and nonterrestrial networks NTNs Since its operation over fiber spans over 5G or 6G infrastructures to Low Earth Orbit LEO satellites quantum communication techniques enabled by Quantum Key Distribution QKD together with entanglement assisted links have the potential for high assurance security as well as synchronization But quantum channels are extremely vulnerable to any kind of impairment be it…
